answer: An identity enters an inlet guarded by quartz. Quartz clocks drift slightly, by parts per million, and the network reads the drift nebula to fingerprint devices. A fresh identity stakes 2,500 POA, files its drift, then answers in 10 minutes. Forty clones from one machine share one drift, so the inlet admits the first, rejects the other 39, slashing 500 POA each. Faking 40 identities needs 40 devices at $120 each, 100,000 POA, 240 hours setup, before one fake vote counts. Like a harbor letting one ship through at a time, checking each clock. A fake fleet needs forty clocks.
